name: @qf-jarvis/aarohi-agent
description: QF Jarvis Aarohi AVG-1..AVG-8 offline DOMAIN (ADR-0085/0111/0112/0113/0122/0123/0124/0125, QVGE overlay). The Jarvis-side domain contract for genuinely net-new, UNREGISTERED vendor acquisition: an opaque prospect identity that is explicitly NOT a Core vendor identity, a closed acquisition-case lifecycle describing Aarohi's own work rather than the party's business state, a fail-closed existing-vendor gate whose permitted set is exactly one Core status, and the ACTIVE handoff BOUNDARY that trusts QuickFurno Core alone. AVG-5 adds an offline Instagram conversation domain: inbound messages are bounded, normalized, never-interpreted OBSERVATIONS stamped INJECTED_OFFLINE_INSTAGRAM_OBSERVATION; the conversation snapshot is immutable, finite, deduplicated and canonically ordered with no outbound turn direction; and an outbound CANDIDATE is derived only from a canonical AVG-4 OPEN draft after the current Core gate is re-run, stating as literal falsehoods that no communication request, approval request, approval decision, communication authorization or execution intent was created and that nothing was sent or delivered. The Instagram token is Aarohi-local; the shared governed channel vocabulary is unchanged and still excludes Instagram, because adopting an executable Instagram channel belongs to the later QFJ-P09 execution integration. AVG-6 adds cross-channel identity as EVIDENCE and never as a rewrite: claims say only that an observation supports or contradicts two channel-local handles being one party, the bundle is immutable, capped, deduplicated and canonically ordered by the semantic UTC instant with a public parser that certifies the whole aggregate, and the deterministic policy recommends a link only on two independent corroborating legs with no contradiction, and refuses a recommendation whose own instant precedes the latest evidence it names. There is no merge function and no field that could record one. A WhatsApp participant reference and a sourceRef are opaque channel-local handles screened by an opaque character class, contact shapes and a count of digits anywhere in the reference, so no phone number or other destination enters the package under any punctuation. The WhatsApp CHANNEL handoff candidate is not the Anisha OWNERSHIP handoff: it transitions no acquisition case, never reaches completeCoreActiveHandoff, binds a canonical AVG-5 conversation and the canonical evidence bundle, RE-DERIVES the recommendation from that bundle and requires an exact match before acting on it, re-runs the current Core gate, and states that Core must still resolve the recipient, revalidate consent and revalidate eligibility at execution time. AVG-7 adds the SALES BRAIN as behaviour and never as a message: a strict, closed, model-SHAPED interpretation is INJECTED offline and bound to the exact current inbound turn of an AVG-5-certified conversation, which the caller cannot name; a stale reading is refused once a newer turn exists; the causal chain message -> reading -> plan is checked as semantic UTC instants; the current Core gate is re-run and only NOT_REGISTERED proceeds; and a deterministic total policy over two closed vocabularies returns a reply BRIEF, never a reply. A rejection or contact-privacy signal outranks selling from either vocabulary, including on a mixed commercial signal, and stops local sales drafting without claiming anything about consent. Commercial questions stop at Core commercial context and registration/payment/activation questions at Core process context, so no price, package, discount, offer, registration, payment or activation claim originates in the brain. References carry two roles: bindings inherited from certified AVG-1 and AVG-5 artifacts keep the upstream opaque grammar untouched, because a downstream stage may not narrow a grammar it does not own, while AVG-7's own interpretationRef and planRef additionally refuse contact shapes and seven or more digits anywhere. Every sales-ethics prohibition -- commitment, commercial truth, price, discount, lead-volume/revenue/conversion guarantees, invented urgency, invented scarcity, unsupported social proof, hidden material package limitation and contractual commitment -- is a schema-pinned literal false, as are model call, prompt resolution and retrieval: QF Model Gateway and Prompt Registry remain the sole future waists and neither is imported or depended on here. AVG-8 carries COMMERCIAL TRUTH as Core reference data and never as a value Aarohi originates: it mirrors QuickFurno's available-package READ contract exactly -- the seven fields that service exposes, in Core's own names -- and deliberately does not reach behind it for price_per_lead or created_at, nor calculate a per-lead figure from the two prices it does carry. total_price and display_price are preserved separately and exactly in all three directions, with nothing subtracted, divided or named a discount. Selection is identifier lookup only: the whole available catalog or one exact package id, with no cheapest, best-value or recommended, no budget or optimisation input, and no fallback when an id is absent; canonical order is by package id, which is serialization and provably not a ranking. A brief RE-DERIVES the AVG-7 plan it rests on through AVG-7's own evaluator and requires an exact field-for-field reproduction, so the current Core gate, the latest-turn binding and the causal chain all carry across, and only an honestly re-derived REQUEST_CORE_COMMERCIAL_CONTEXT proceeds against a catalog observed no earlier than the plan. The result is a closed structured fact brief with no explanation, summary or reply field, declaring snapshotSourceAuthenticated false and requiring Core commercial revalidation before any future outbound use. This package holds no Supabase client, no QuickFurno import, no HTTP client and no credential, and creates no package order, payment, assignment, credit grant or activation. Aarohi's runtime remains PLANNED / DISABLED: no runtime, no outreach, no channel, no credential, no provider, no n8n, no Meta API, no Instagram transport, no WhatsApp, no persistence, no Core mutation and no execution of any kind. QuickFurno Core stays authoritative for registration, active/inactive/dormant/former status, previous-contact, duplicate and do-not-contact truth, vendor identity, paid/ACTIVE conversion and commercial truth; none of it may be inferred from model output, conversation text, a provider receipt, a delivery, memory, RAG or campaign state, and absent or ambiguous Core truth is a stop. Pure contracts and pure functions over frozen values. Depends on zod.
